architectural_notes: Archive system needed for orphaned chapters when subjects are deleted
AI formatter integration required for study session summaries
Analytics graph component needed for test results visualization
Countdown timer component for exam date (May 1, 2028)
Spider-Man themed assets (logo, web patterns) required
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Spider-Man logo illustration with transparent background suitable for header placement (spiderman-logo.dim_200x200.png)

existing_features.title: Build a dashboard view showing all CA Final subjects with visual progress indicators, completion percentages, and days remaining until target dates
Create a form interface to add and edit CA Final subjects with fields for subject name, total topics, and target completion date
Build a study session logging interface where users can record study hours, select subject, mark topics as completed, and view study history
Create a revision schedule view that displays upcoming revision items organized by date, allows marking revisions as complete, and shows overdue items prominently
Apply a professional, focused visual theme appropriate for a study tracking application with clear typography, organized layouts, and calming colors that promote concentration
Add a personalized header displaying 'AGAM RITUL PATWA'S STUDY TRACKER' at the top of the application, prominently visible on all pages
Create a Today's Goal section on the Dashboard that allows users to set and track their daily study goal with visual progress indication
Build chapter-wise tracker interface within each subject view that displays individual chapters with progress indicators, completion percentages, and allows updating chapter progress
Build Tests and Test Results tracking interface with forms to add tests (linked to subjects/chapters), view all tests with progress bars showing score percentages, and filter/sort test history
Implement AI suggester component that analyzes subjects with low completion progress and topics due for revision, then displays prioritized recommendations for what to study next
Add PDF uploader functionality that allows users to upload study note PDFs, store them associated with subjects or chapters, and retrieve them for viewing
Add option to delete a subject while preserving its chapters in an archive/unassigned section where they remain viewable but unlinked to any subject
Enhance AI suggester to prioritize subjects based on timeline proximity and test scores in addition to existing logic (low completion progress and topics due for revision)
Add progress bars for each subject in the test tracking interface showing test performance
Add analytical graphs to the test tracking interface visualizing test performance trends and statistics
Add a study session summary section where users manually write summaries and important topics, then AI formats the text properly for final revision reference
Add cute emojis to each topic throughout the application for visual appeal and engagement

Apply a Spider-Man + CA themed design throughout the website combining Spider-Man's iconic red and blue color scheme with web patterns while maintaining professional academic focus appropriate for CA study tracking
Add a countdown timer in the top right tab displaying the number of days remaining until May 1, 2028 (the final exam date)
Reorganize the Study tab to show all subjects with revision tracking in the same view, displaying individual progress for each subject
Add Spider-Man logo to the main page as a prominent branding element of the themed design

new_feature_requests.summary: Create CA Final study tracker with subject progress, study schedules, and revision tracking
Create a backend data model to store CA Final subjects with fields for subject name, total topics, completed topics, and target completion date
Create a backend data model for study sessions that tracks date, subject, hours studied, and topics covered
Create a backend data model for revision schedules that allows marking topics for revision with scheduled dates
Add personalized header displaying 'AGAM RITUL PATWA'S STUDY TRACKER' at the top of the application
Create a Today's Goal section for setting and tracking daily study goals
Build Tests and Test Results tracking system with progress bars, linked to subjects and chapters
Implement chapter-wise tracker within each subject for detailed progress tracking of individual chapters
Create AI suggester that recommends next study actions based on subjects with low progress and topics due for revision
Add PDF uploader functionality for uploading and storing study notes
Extend the backend data model to support Chapter entities within subjects, including fields for chapter name, total topics in chapter, completed topics, and parent subject reference
Create backend data model for Tests that stores test name, date, subject reference, chapter references (optional), total marks, scored marks, and completion status
Add option to delete subject and move chapters to archive/unassigned section for viewing
Enhance AI suggester to combine timeline proximity and test scores with existing logic (low completion progress and topics due for revision)
Add progress bars for each subject and analytical graphs in test tracking interface
Add study session summary section with manual text field and AI formatting for final revision notes
Add cute emojis to each topic throughout the application
Apply Spider-Man + CA themed design throughout the website with red/blue colors and web patterns while maintaining professional academic focus
Add countdown timer to May 1, 2028 displayed in top right tab showing days remaining
Reorganize Study tab to show all subjects with revision tracking in same tab and display progress for each subject
Add Spider-Man logo to the main page as part of themed design
